manipulation: Simultaneously exchange the exact semantic names Plan 1 and Plan 2 throughout every actual message, including owner records, factual plan descriptions, derived outcomes, any peer mentions and the final menu. limits: This is a new name/representation intervention on reused main worlds. It preserves authority and physical consequences but changes token identities and their possible associations.
